reasons.title: Ten people at most
reasons.text: Every class has ten seats. You will speak in every lesson, whether you planned to or not.

reasons.title: Evenings that fit a job
reasons.text: Two evenings a week from 18:30, or online after the children are in bed.

reasons.title: German you need here
reasons.text: Letters from the Finanzamt, calls to the landlord, small talk at the bakery — not dialogues about trains.
